summary: The test audit graded all 17 criteria of Kiln Model Modes against the PRD: 13 are Adequate and 4 are Weak (AC-SAVE-04, AC-ROW-01, AC-WHEN-03, AC-GUIDE-01), none Missing and no mapped test failing. Ten red checks, covering every high-risk Adequate criterion plus AC-SAVE-05 and AC-PRD-01, each broke the riskiest stated part, and a test caught every one. The remaining work is one batch of test fixes recorded in test-audit.md: three red checks still to run (AC-MODE-01, AC-WHEN-01, AC-SAVE-02) and the four Weak rows, with AC-SAVE-04 (own settings kept across an upgrade) first because it is high risk.
